scope: Retrospective matched comparator development on all previously used 72 settings; not unseen-task confirmation or end-to-end power
information: Every method sees exact category probabilities and identical independent focal/reference pairs with both channels and fixed nuisance fits
cost: 2*m raw observations for m paired comparisons; within-category reshuffling and full averaging buy no new labels, computational time separate
split_balanced: Uniform random half-subset within each focal category, seed component991, used only as allocation comparator
pooled_grid: 17 fixed exponents -8 through8; log(3*17/delta) linear penalty; no selecting an unpenalized grid point
pooled_mixture: Gaussian integration of both-sign Jensen MGFs; rho=D/(2*log(3/delta)) fixed using counts and masses
decisions: Each method evaluated separately at its full stated delta; no post hoc minimum across methods is a valid claimed certificate
outcomes: All settings and adverse outcomes retained; original delta=.05 rectangle/split outputs must replay within1e-12
